backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister implementing taxi pickup logging with access control, user profiles, pickups, customers, daily reports, and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a scrolling fix in Edit/Delete Record dialog to its related file and components with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-like list summarizing frontend files and their purposes across forms, dialogs, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx into the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app controlling authentication flow, actor initialization gating, and routing between login, setup, and main app.
frontend/src/components/AboutDialog.tsx: Dialog component showing app description, copyright info, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/ActorInitializat: Wrapper that blocks rendering until the backend actor is ready, showing loading or error states.
frontend/src/components/CustomerLookup.t: Customer search and selection combobox supporting suggestions, free‑text entry, and loading states.
frontend/src/components/CycleBalanceDial: Dialog that fetches and displays the canister's current cycle balance with refresh and error states.
frontend/src/components/DailyReportDialo: Generates daily pickup reports by date range, deduplicating pickups and calculating aggregated totals.
frontend/src/components/DeleteAllRecords: Confirmation dialog to delete all stored records, with mutation handling and UI state for progress.
frontend/src/components/DeleteDraftDataD: Empty placeholder component file with no implemented logic.
frontend/src/components/EditDeleteRecord: Dialog for selecting, editing, and deleting individual pickup records with detailed form handling.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog for viewing and updating driver profile details with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/ExportImportDial: Dialog for exporting data to JSON and importing files, including deduplication, previews, and confirmation steps.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying credits and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GeneratePDFDialo: Dialog component that opens a new window and renders styled HTML content for printing or saving a PDF.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with navigation menu, theme toggle, identity actions, and multiple dialog triggers.
frontend/src/components/PickupForm.tsx: Form for entering a taxi pickup with customer lookups, auto-population, payment fields, and submission logic.
frontend/src/components/PickupList.tsx: Lists all pickups for a selected date, computes totals, and displays sorted pickup records.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Wrapper around useActor that exposes simplified readiness state and a basic refetch method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and status tracking via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating profiles, pickups, and customer suggestions using the backend actor with readiness checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines light and dark theme CSS variables for colors and layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AccountSetupPage.tsx: Renders a profile setup form with validation and mutation to save user profile data.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Displays the login UI with Internet Identity sign‑in and theme toggle.
frontend/src/pages/LoginSelectionPage.ts: Empty placeholder file for login selection page.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Main app view showing pickup entry and listing for a selected date.
frontend/src/utils/errorMessage.ts: Utility to extract a stable string message from unknown error objects.
frontend/src/utils/numberFormat.ts: Provides safe number formatting and parsing helpers for currency, fixed decimals, and floats.
frontend/src/utils/owedDriver.ts: Calculates the amount owed to a driver based on meter totals and tips.
frontend/src/utils/pickupGuards.ts: Safe conversion utilities for timestamps between bigint nanoseconds and JavaScript date/time formats.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining content paths, custom theme extensions, color variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing known issues and an existing feature request focused on fixing scrolling behavior in the Edit/Delete Record dialog.
